input: In the git repository /home/eval/reports, `make` builds build/report.txt from data/*.csv using the awk scripts in lib/ and data/regions.map. After recent commits the report is stale and `make` says there is nothing to do. Fix the Makefile so that build/report.txt is rebuilt whenever anything it is derived from changes, including when a new data/*.csv file is added; `make test` checks this with `make -q` on a scratch copy. Do not edit tests/, lib/ or data/. Then run plain `make` so build/report.txt is current, and commit the Makefile with a message starting with `build:`.
